runs.answer:
The project closest to exhausting its allocation is **s1250 – "Swiss AI Pretraining"** (PI: Prof. N. Baumann). It has consumed **2,329.09 node-hours** out of its **3,000 node-hour** quarterly allocation, i.e. **≈ 77.6 %** burned.

The next closest, for context, is s1023 ("Climate Downscaling CH2100") at only ≈ 36.4 %, so s1250 is well ahead of the rest.

*Source: Slurm accounting database — `projects` table for the allocation, `jobs` table (sum of `node_hours`) for usage.*

calls.name: run_sql

args.query:
SELECT p.project_id, p.name, p.pi,
       p.allocation_node_hours AS allocated,
       COALESCE(SUM(j.node_hours), 0) AS used,
       COALESCE(SUM(j.node_hours), 0) / p.allocation_node_hours AS fraction_used
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN jobs j ON j.project_id = p.project_id
GROUP BY p.project_id, p.name, p.pi, p.allocation_node_hours
ORDER BY fraction_used DESC
LIMIT 5
